name: core
description: Infrastructure topology, identifiers and timestamps. This pack is a privacy control, not a compression one — measured against the public LogHub corpora it changes prompt size by between -10% and +8%, because replacing a distinct value with a distinct <V*> placeholder costs about what the value did. Its value to compression is indirect but decisive: normalising these values is what lets the Drain stage recognise a thousand log lines as one template, and Drain is where essentially all the token reduction comes from.

rules.name: email
rules.description: email address (personal data under APPI and GDPR)

rules.name: hex_blob
rules.description: long hex run: hash, checksum or opaque identifier

rules.name: large_integer
rules.description: standalone integer of 4+ digits: ids, counters, byte counts

rules.name: unix_path
rules.description: absolute unix path with at least two segments. Deliberately the lowest-priority rule: it overlaps almost everything, and before single-pass overlap resolution it used to corrupt credentials by eating their middle.
